releaseNotes: Expanded verified reader beta from six to nine sources: adds MangaDex, MangaKatana and repaired Asura Scans.
Asura uses current browse/comics routes, deduplicated responsive listings and the full chapter image list. Legacy source IDs and existing download policies are preserved.
Comix, MangaFire and WeebCentral remain tracked candidates, excluded from verified delivery because live acceptance failed.
Canary only. Bounded live checks include search pagination where supported, details, chapters, multiple Asura pages and actual first-image bytes. Physical-device acceptance is separate.
